scope: New BoneHub MC I/III rigid shape-registration and bounded foot image-header followup only

structures.method: PCA main axis signed away from named carpals; 4 quarter-turn starts; symmetric whole-surface rigid ICP. Separate shaft60 fits assess sensitivity. No scale/reflection/deformation and no neighbour-dependent objective. Source patient LPS translated into current Three world through one saved proper rigid matrix for each candidate.

shaftSensitivity.note: Shape registration depends on weighting of shaft and endpoints; no accepted anatomical base/head landmarks are encoded.

structures.blocker: New donor shape can be rigidly aligned approximately, but residual intersections with working base/head neighbours remain. Surface assignment and anatomical pose not independently confirmed; choosing another transform solely to remove collisions would be unsupported. This is not a claim that the source bone is intrinsically pathological or unusable as a separately identified specimen.
structures.nextStep: Review saved Blender views for base/head/shaft orientation and recorded crossing patches. Confirm anatomical landmarks before changing registration; if no coherent pose exists, evaluate the complete matched-donor region separately, preserving working BP3D neighbours.
